# Steve Schmitt for Ward 1, County of Brant

> Steve Schmitt is a candidate for Ward 1 Councillor in the County of Brant,
> Ontario, Canada, in the municipal election on Monday, October 26, 2026.
> Official campaign website: https://steveschmitt.ca

## Who is Steve Schmitt?

Steve Schmitt is a lifelong resident of St. George, Ontario (in the South
Dumfries area of the County of Brant). He is a local entrepreneur and
electrician who built two businesses of his own, Electra Modern Controls
(nearly 30 years) and Nature's Way Gardens landscaping, and served as
property manager for the Tim Hortons camps. He lives on his St. George homestead with his wife Holly
and has seven grandchildren.

## Community and municipal experience

- 3 terms as South Dumfries Councillor
- 2 terms as County of Brant Councillor for Ward 1
- President of the South Dumfries Historical Society (six years to present)
- Correspondent for the Ayr News, providing a local voice for St. George
- Member and Past President, Royal Canadian Legion Branch 605
- Current member, County of Brant Committee of Adjustment

## Priorities

1. Infrastructure Before Development: careful consideration of
   infrastructure needs and capacity when planning future development.
2. Fiscal Responsibility: informed decision-making and financial planning,
   with attention to costs and their impact on property taxpayers.
3. Communication & Public Confidence: improved communication between
   municipal government and residents, with more public involvement and
   consultations.
4. Rural & Cultural Heritage: protecting the area's rural character,
   cultural heritage, and natural resources.

## Election facts

- Office sought: Ward 1 Councillor, County of Brant, Ontario
- Ward 1 covers the South Dumfries area, including St. George, Glen Morris, and Harrisburg
- Election day: Monday, October 26, 2026 (Ontario municipal and school board
  elections)
- Official election information: https://www.brant.ca
